{"edit_description":"Create a NEW file `snake_zai-glm-5.3_01.html`: a complete, polished, self-contained single-file Snake game (HTML + inline CSS + inline JavaScript, no external assets, no CDNs, no imports). It must implement ALL of the following exactly:

=== OVERALL LAYOUT & STYLE (CSS) ===
- Dark theme: page background = deep slate gradient (e.g. radial/linear from #0b1220 to #0f172a), centered column layout.
- Header: game title "SNAKE" in bold neon-green letterspaced text with a small subtitle "30 × 30 Arena".
- A score bar above the canvas: two "player chips" (colored dot + name + live score), a center mode label, and it stays visible during gameplay. Chip colors match snake colors.
- Canvas wrapper (position:relative, width:min(600px, 92vmin), aspect-ratio 1/1) containing a <canvas width="600" height="600"> (CSS width:100%) plus absolutely-positioned overlay panels.
- Overlay panels (.overlay): full-size flex-centered translucent dark backdrop (rgba(2,6,23,.82), backdrop-filter: blur(4px)), inner rounded panel (border 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25), background #0f172a, padding, border-radius, box-shadow). A `.hidden { display:none; }` class toggles them.
- Three overlays: #menuOverlay, #gameOverOverlay, #pauseOverlay.
- Styled <kbd> elements for key hints (monospace, border, border-radius, padding, background #1e293b).
- Colors: Snake P1 = #4ade80 (green), Snake P2 = #38bdf8 (blue), food = #f87171 (red apple with glow). Dead snake dimmed.
- Footer hint line under canvas with key legend.

=== GAME CONSTANTS & STATE ===
- GRID = 30 (cells per side), CELL = 20, canvas 600×600.
- Game states: 'menu', 'running', 'paused', 'over'. Modes: 'hh' (human vs human), 'ch' (cpu vs human), 'cc' (cpu vs cpu).
- Two Snake objects, each: segments array of {x,y} (head = index 0), dir {x,y}, pendingDirs queue (max length 3), score (start 0), isCPU bool, color, name, alive bool.
- Initial snakes (length 3): P1 head at (7,8) facing right, body extending to the left; P2 head at (22,21) facing left, body extending to the right. P1 name "Green", P2 name "Blue". In mode 'hh': both human (P1 = WASD, P2 = Arrow keys). In 'ch': P1 human controlled by BOTH WASD and Arrow keys, P2 is CPU. In 'cc': both CPU.
- food = {x,y} spawned on a random free cell (never on any snake segment). Respawn each time eaten.
- Main loop: requestAnimationFrame with timestamp accumulator; tick interval starts at 120 ms and decreases by 2 ms per food eaten, clamped to minimum 70 ms (track total foods eaten). Draw every frame.
- Score: +10 per food eaten; eating also grows the snake (tail not removed that tick).

=== INPUT (keydown listener on window) ===
- Always e.preventDefault() for Arrow keys and Space to stop page scrolling.
- In 'menu': keys "1"/"2"/"3" start modes hh/ch/cc respectively (also clickable buttons in the menu overlay do the same).
- In 'running': human direction keys push into that snake's pendingDirs queue (only if the new dir is not the same as, and not the opposite of, the last queued dir or current dir if queue empty); "p" toggles pause; "r" restarts current mode; "m" or Escape returns to menu.
- In 'paused': "p" resumes; "r" restarts; "m"/Escape menu. Show pauseOverlay while paused.
- In 'over': "r", Enter, or Space restarts the SAME mode; "m" or Escape returns to menu.
- Returning to menu stops the loop (cancel rAF), hides overlays except menu, resets to menu state.

=== TICK LOGIC (both snakes move simultaneously) ===
1. For each alive snake choose next dir: humans shift() from pendingDirs queue if any; CPUs compute dir via AI (below), set as dir.
2. Compute newHead = head + dir for each alive snake.
3. Wall check: newHead outside 0..GRID-1 → that snake dies this tick.
4. Body checks: for each alive snake, newHead equals any segment of its OWN body (excluding its own tail cell, since the tail moves away unless it will eat — acceptable simplification: exclude tail only when not eating) → dies; OR newHead equals any segment of the OTHER snake (excluding the other snake's tail cell when the other snake is not eating) → dies.
5. Head-to-head: both alive and same newHead cell → both die.
6. Apply: for each still-alive snake unshift newHead; if newHead === food cell → score += 10, foodsEaten++, respawn food (keep tail = grow) and DO NOT pop tail; else pop() tail.
7. If any snake died (alive=false): set state 'over', cancel loop, reveal game over overlay: big "GAME OVER"; winner line — if exactly one snake alive: "<ColorName> wins!" colored in winner color; if both dead: "It's a draw!"; final scores for both players; hint "Press R to play again — M for menu". Also dim dead snake in render.

=== CPU AI (function cpuChooseDir(snake, other, food)) ===
- Candidate dirs = 4 cardinal dirs excluding the reverse of current dir.
- Blocked-cell model: every cell occupied by either snake's segments is blocked, EXCEPT the final tail cell of each snake (tails move away).
- First try BFS from snake's head to the food cell over non-blocked cells; if food reachable, return the direction of the first step of the shortest path.
- Fallback survival mode: for each candidate dir whose next cell is in-bounds and not blocked, run a flood fill from that next cell counting reachable free cells; pick the candidate with the largest count (ties broken by preferring the direction that moves toward its own tail, then any).
- If no safe candidate exists, return current dir (snake accepts death).

=== RENDERING (draw()) ===
- Clear canvas; draw subtle grid lines (strokeStyle rgba(148,163,184,0.06), 1px lines every CELL).
- Draw food as glowing red circle (shadowBlur glow) with small green leaf/stem detail.
- Draw each snake as rounded rects per segment: head slightly brighter with two small dark "eyes" offset toward current direction; body segments slightly darker toward tail (simple gradient by index). Dead snakes drawn at 35% opacity.
- Update DOM score bar numbers every tick.

=== MENU OVERLAY CONTENT ===
- Title "SNAKE" + tagline.
- Three mode buttons (real <button>, keyboard hints shown): "1 — Human vs Human" (WASD vs Arrows), "2 — CPU vs Human" (You: WASD/Arrows vs CPU), "3 — CPU vs CPU" (watch the machines). Clicking starts that mode.
- Controls legend table: P1 WASD, P2 Arrow keys, P pause, R restart, M menu.
- Footer: "Press 1, 2 or 3 to start".

=== START / RESTART FUNCTIONS ===
- startGame(mode): reset snakes, scores, dirs, queues, foodsEaten, tick interval, food spawn, state='running', hide all overlays, update score bar labels (show CPU tag on cpu-controlled players), start rAF loop.
- toMenu(): state='menu', cancel loop, show menuOverlay, hide others.

=== CODE QUALITY ===
- Clean, commented vanilla JS in one <script> at end of body; strict mode IIFE or top-level fine; no console errors; all element lookups by id. Wrap everything so it works when opened directly via file:// in a modern browser. Ensure no reference before definition issues and that overlays start in correct visibility (menu visible, others hidden).
